name: Hannah Homicide
source:
A serial killer is on the loose – and you have amnesia. Uncover who you are and where you're headed, all while avoiding both killers and cops.


[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一名连环杀手逍遥法外——而你却失忆了。揭开你是谁以及你要去哪里，同时避开杀手和警察。


[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
